query: Which explicit domain(s) will be held out for testing (vendor, field strength, site, protocol) and how will we construct stratified splits to eliminate leakage and confounding?

response.query: Which explicit domain(s) will be held out for testing (vendor, field strength, site, protocol) and how will we construct stratified splits to eliminate leakage and confounding?
response.answer: The explicit domain held out for testing is the vendor. Stratified splits will be constructed by maintaining the proportion of each vendor in training and test sets to eliminate leakage and confounding.
